name: 수동정찰 종가 피라미딩

universe.adopt: pool stock + non-bot BUY fill (qty>=1) after enable; pre-held only via 'mmg adopt'

schedule.session: 15:15-15:20 continuous (limit, marketable) then 15:20-15:30 closing call auction (trde_tp 0/3 accepted; no dedicated close code)

fallbackAfterHoursClose.note: 장마감후 시간외 종가, verify in paper

trendTemplate.weinsteinStage2: SMA150 rising (vs 20D ago) and close > SMA150

vcp.trigger: close > last contraction high on vol>=1.4x

pullbackMa.trigger: bull close, close > prior high, vol < 50D avg on pullback

exits.initialStopRule: max(-8% from avg, setup stop(box bottom / pivot low / MA50))
exits.tightenAfterAdd: stop = max(prev stop, last add setup low*0.99, avg*0.97 after 2nd add)

partialTp.climax: 3-day gain>=25% or gap+wide range on record vol

exits.trail: close < SMA10 (if gain>=20%) else close < SMA20 -> sell half; close < SMA50 -> exit
exits.scoutOnlyRule: 1-share scout never stopped intraday; EOD EXIT if trend template fails 2 closes
exits.orderType: limit (EOD, ceilToKrxTick, -2 ticks from last) ; market for catastrophic intraday

screener.universe: KOSPI+KOSDAQ, close>=1000, 20D avg value>=5bn KRW, exclude ETF/SPAC/managed

signals.E1: close crosses above SMA150 + vol>=1.5x50D + SMA150 slope20>=-2%
signals.E2: close>20D high, vol>=1.5x, close>=85% 52wHigh, close>SMA50, 20D box range<=20%
signals.E3: SMA20 crosses above SMA60 + vol5>=1.2x vol50 + close>SMA20
signals.NEAR: trend template + close within 3% of 20D high (watch only)

schedule: 15:10 intraday rescan of watch for 15:15 signal

autoScout.rule: screener pick + E1-E4 on day close -> buy 1 share at 15:15-15:20 (limit floorToKrxTick? use marketable limit), max 2 new/day, same caps

rules.prereq: MTS01 v64: onBrokerFill 체결선착 대기복구는 봇 주문번호/MTS01 관리종목만
rules.masters: O'Neil pivot+vol, <=5% ext, -7~8% stop, 20-25% TP | Minervini trend template, VCP, pyramid up | Livermore add only in profit | Darvas box | Weinstein stage2/30W
rules.unfilled: EOD limit not filled by 15:30 -> cancel (ADD skipped; SL/EXIT retried next day 09:05 with marketable limit)

notes: DRAFT rev3 — uncommitted, enabled=false; screener/autoScout design only

live.maxBuyAmtSetting: settings.json mmgMaxBuyAmtPerStk (설정 탭 '종목당 최대 매수금액', 기본 3,000,000원)

schedule.order: 15:21-15:27 지정가(±2% 여유, v63 호가) → 종가 동시호가

filters.earnings: DART 영업이익 YoY≥+20% 또는 흑자전환 (공시마감 지연 적용)
filters.index: KOSPI 또는 KOSDAQ 종가 > SMA50 (자동정찰·스크리너 추가)
